content.short: A capital-efficient DEX and launchpad on Mantle Network featuring concentrated liquidity and ve(3,3) tokenomics.
content.description:
AGNI Finance is a capital-efficient decentralized exchange and launchpad built on the Mantle Network. It utilizes concentrated liquidity, allowing providers to allocate capital within specific price ranges to minimize slippage and maximize fee earnings. The protocol employs ve(3,3) tokenomics, where governance token holders vote on emissions and share in the protocol-generated revenue.

Integrated with Mantle's modular architecture, AGNI offers hyperscale performance and low transaction costs. Its launchpad includes a "Safety Net" insurance pool to protect early participants, making it a secure and efficient platform for both traders and new project launches.
